clauses.requiredBehavior: Inspect and reuse qualified, versioned components.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Duplicate an owned capability for convenience.
clauses.binding: Reuse the qualified original harness library (test_f3a_independent.post-AMEND4.py), the readjudication gap harness (test_readj_gaps.py), the G5a persisted-content test, the D06-M06 mutant diff and the fixture builders; do not duplicate or rewrite them in assignments. New fixtures only for the F5 class-age masked-host case, as foundation pieces.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Identify the controlling source, external reliance boundary, duties, expected acceptance and the authority by which a proposed change may acquire canonical standing.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Start against an unnamed or mutable contract.
clauses.binding: Controlling sources are exact-source bound: CP 739efe7, Registry r08-v8 pin a40fe755, doc 03 (frozen oracle), doc 06 and record 11 (successor interpretation; builder-prepared, unsigned, human adoption pending), PROTOCOL-F3-v1 sha e799b108 and PROTOCOL-F3A-READJ-v1 sha 04f4f950. No assignment tests to an invented oracle. Canonical standing of any closure rests on the Architect/competent authority, not on this document.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Qualification is designed before acceptance and kept apart: this coordinator inspects and plans; fresh Archetype D owners execute and judge; the competent certifier decides; integration follows. The coordinator produced the F3-A readjudication evidence (PR #242) and therefore may not be the independent owner for any Q item that depends on it; this is disclosed in every artifact.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Version, authenticate and review governance-critical policy and rule changes; protect established mandatory invariants against configuration override.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Treat unreviewed settings or evaluator changes as governing authority, weaken mandatory checks or introduce an unaccountable decision path.
clauses.binding: Protected invariants are not touched: no guard (authority_domain_mismatch, manifest_digest_mismatch, runtime_authority_approval_mismatch) is disabled to expose a binding check; no evaluator, oracle or test expectation is edited; no unreviewed setting is treated as governing. The proposed designation and adoption texts are PROPOSED, unsigned and activate nothing.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Preserve relied-upon external semantics or obtain an explicit authorized compatibility transition.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Introduce silent contract, rights, evidence or interface regressions through internal refactoring.
clauses.binding: External interface commitments are preserved: no implementation or schema change; reason vocabulary, approval_commitment, catalogue_digest and published schemas are untouched; the standing holds (Registry #58/#59, CP #87, Ed25519 #26/#34, constructor tolerance, V09, release) remain as recorded.
